a11y-color-not-only-cue.reason: Each status pairs its colored dot with the word Live or Failed.

layout-separators-last.reason: Rows are split by faint hairlines inside a tight list where no gap could carry the split.

layout-static-not-control-shaped.reason: No badge or static element looks like a button.

layout-importance-order.reason: Each row leads with the app name and ends with its status.

layout-content-bleeds-controls-float.reason: All text and the list sit inside the page margin.

14-pair-for-contrast.reason: One sans-serif family in two weights, no near-duplicate pairing.

color-semantic-not-against-meaning.reason: Green marks live deploys and red marks the failed one.

ui-optical-asymmetric-glyphs.reason: No asymmetric icon on the screen.

ui-shadow-for-depth.reason: The list border is structural on a plain page, not a depth border over an image.

ui-icon-outline-fill-states.reason: No icon with states on the screen.

13-low-cognitive-load.reason: One heading and a three-row list, simple and predictable.

break-content-shape.reason: Short Latin names only, nothing that stresses content shape.
